subject: Supplier invoice batch windows — proposal to reconcile Net term cadence
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@blueoak.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@blueoak.io
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueOak onboarding docs + invoicing cadence question

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for sending over the vendor enrollment link yesterday. Attached are the completed onboarding form and our standard work order (WO-BlueOak-0922). Two quick items for alignment before we finalize:

1) Our finance team issues invoices on the 1st and 16th of each month (mid-month + month-start). Can Redwood accept bi-monthly invoice batches, or do you prefer consolidated monthly invoices?

2) Our standard payment term is Net 45. We saw in your vendor portal options for Net 30 / Net 60 as well — can you confirm Redwood's preferred default and whether early-pay discounts are available (e.g., 2% 10)?

I've attached the files for your team to review. Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Attachments: BlueOak_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), WO-BlueOak-0922.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Elena Martinez
Sr. Vendor Operations
BlueOak Systems
 elena@blueoak.io
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@blueoak.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueOak onboarding docs + invoicing cadence question

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the docs. Looping in Kimberly (AP lead) and Vanessa (Vendor Ops) to confirm how to map your bi-monthly batches into our PO + payment lanes. Priyom is copied for procurement audit items.

Short answers up front:
- We can accept bi-monthly invoices (1st + 16th) but need them routed to the correct PO number and invoice lane to ensure they hit our mid-month close.
- Standard Redwood terms for new vendors are Net 45 by default; Net 30 can be approved for strategic partners. Net 60 possible for extended-cycle suppliers, but it requires procurement approval and a different PO cadence.

Questions for you so we can finalize the mapping:
1) Can BlueOak include a per-invoice sequence number on the WO (e.g., WO-0922-1, WO-0922-2) so AP can reconcile two invoices to the same PO each month?
2) Do your invoices include a P.O. field and the deliverable period (e.g., services for 1–15 Sep)?

If you can confirm both, we should be able to onboard you under Net 45 and accept both bi-monthly invoice batches. If BlueOak prefers Net 30 or requests an early-pay discount, we'll need a short approval from Finance (cc'd).

Propose a 20-minute call tomorrow 9–9:30am PT if that works for you.

—Mateo
Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@blueoak.io>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueOak onboarding docs + invoicing cadence question

Thanks, Mateo / Elena —

Reviewed the attachments. Quick AP notes:
- We can process two invoices per PO per month provided the invoices are labeled distinctly and include the PO number + service period. Sequence numbering (WO-0922-1 / -2) is ideal.
- Cutoff for our mid-month close is the 18th at 11:59PM PT; invoices dated/received by the 16th will be included in the mid-month run. Invoices received after that move to next month.
- For Net 30 requests: Finance wants a short rationale (strategic partnership or volume-tier) and an estimate of annual spend to assess cashflow impact.
- Early-pay discounts (e.g., 2% 10) are evaluated on a case-by-case basis; we prefer volume-based pilots rather than blanket discounts for new vendors.

Action items I can take:
- Approve bi-monthly invoice routing if BlueOak sends sequence numbers and the PO field.
- Run a one-off Net 30 impact memo if BlueOak requests it (need expected monthly invoice $).

Elena — can you confirm the sequence numbering and typical monthly run-rate? If you prefer the Net 30 request, please provide the 6-month expected spend and we will route to Finance.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Accounts Payable Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena@blueoak.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueOak onboarding docs + invoicing cadence question

Thanks all —

Confirming: we will add per-invoice sequence numbers (WO-0922-1 and WO-0922-2) and include the PO number + service window on each invoice. Our expected monthly billings to Redwood are approximately $38k–$45k.

Regarding Net 30: BlueOak would like to request Net 30 for the first six months as we ramp. We would not require an early-pay discount; our preference is simply the shorter payment window to help cashflow during ramp.

If acceptable, please let me know what documentation you need for the Net 30 pilot (a short purchase estimate should suffice). If not, we will proceed under Net 45 and send the two invoices per PO.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Elena
